stem: A later scouting round changes from 25 plants per zone to only the most symptomatic plants. What is the primary data-quality concern?
choices: The later round is automatically more accurate.
Only positive plants should ever be sampled.
The sampling method changed toward a biased subset, so trend comparability is weakened.
Sample count does not affect trend interpretation.
rationale: The sampling method changed toward a biased subset, so trend comparability is weakened.
